purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Chaman

queries.query: Chaman Balochistan Pakistan cadastral parcel map land records official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official District Administration E-Chaman service and the Balochistan Board of Revenue land-record/BLRMIS pages. The public Balochistan GLIS map portal exposes a parcel API and control-level API, but its current district-level coverage response did not list Chaman or Killa Abdullah. No safe city parcel identity-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: چمن بلوچستان پاکستان کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ سرکاری
queries.result: First-party Urdu-language discovery did not expose a separate Chaman parcel viewer or downloadable parcel layer. The official Balochistan Board of Revenue pages provide land-revenue laws/manuals and BLRMIS project material; the public GLIS service was then inspected as the available map/API route.

nationalCustodians: Government of Balochistan Board of Revenue; Balochistan Land Records Management Information System (BLRMIS)
registryEvidence.localLead: District Administration Chaman's official E-Chaman portal is evidenced as a local administrative service, but its retrieved public description does not identify a cadastral parcel map or parcel API.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Provincial land-record custodianship and a public Balochistan GLIS map service are evidenced. Chaman-specific public parcel coverage and a local registry/map service were not verified, so registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official District Administration Chaman E-Administration portal; retrieved description lists public administrative/document services, not a parcel-vector service.
Official Board of Revenue downloads page lists the Balochistan Land Revenue Act, land administration manual, and land record manual.

Official Board of Revenue BLRMIS project page identifies provincial land-record computerization responsibilities; page content was partially corrupted at retrieval, so no city coverage claim is made from it.
Public GLIS viewer current JavaScript config identifies GIS API base https://api.ssbacha.net and POST routes /api/parcels/filtered and /api/levels/filtered.

parcelDiscovery.note: The API returned a sample polygon for an unrelated covered district when called with {limit:1}; its safe schema included OBJECTID and KhassraId among source fields, but no Chaman geometry was returned. No raw source attributes or unrelated polygon are retained.
